profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Salesforce
profile.summary: Heetae is currently a Principal Software Engineer working on a database at Salesforce. Before joining Salesforce, he was a Software Engineer at Amazon Web Services for 5 years building EBS APIs, EBS Outposts, and EBS Snapshots. He received his master's degree at University of Southern California after working as a Software Engineer at Samsung for 4 years.

positions.title: SDE Intern
positions.description:
API Availability Generator
- Designed and implemented the system that gathers daily performance metrics and generates API availability reports to check SLA of Elastic Block Store.
- Identified data discrepancy of the old system and deprecated it with the new API Availability Generator.
- Over-delivered Java 8 and Spring framework 4 migration for the reporting website besides the assigned project.
- Achieved 100% unit test coverage for all the code and branches by writing extensible test cases.

positions.title: Freelance Software Engineer
positions.description: Designed and developed an application to predict the amount of crude oil production.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Government Benefits and Beneficiaries Management System
- Implemented more than 50 SQL, PL/SQL, and web application modules to ingest income and asset information of government benefit applicants.
- Optimized SQL queries and reduced batch execution time of PL/SQL from more than 2 days to 10 hours when evaluating benefit qualifications of 15 million people.

positions.title: Software Engineering Intern
positions.description:
Military Unit Communication Simulator
- Designed overall software architecture of the program and implemented using C++, DirectX, and MFC.
- Designed broadcast message packets using UDP to communicate among machines without explicit connections.
